entities.summary: Marat Tūrdybekūly Ospanov was a Kazakh politician. He was the 1st Chairman of the Mäjilis from 1996 to 1999, a member of the Supreme Council from 1990 to 1993, the Deputy Chairman of the Supreme Council from 1994 to 1995, and a Deputy Minister of Finance from 1992 to 1994.
